description: This file defines an abstract base class for image generation services that convert text prompts into images, primarily using AI models. It includes method signatures that subclasses must implement to generate images from text prompts.

classes.name: ImageGenService
classes.description: Abstract base class for AI-powered image generation services, extending AIService. It processes text frames as prompts and requires subclasses to implement run_image_gen for actual image creation.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_image_gen(self, prompt: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to generate images from a text prompt. Must be implemented by subclasses; yields frames containing generated images.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Handles incoming frames, passes through non-TextFrames directly, and processes TextFrames as prompts for image generation, with metrics tracking.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/

ctags.name: run_image_gen
ctags.pattern: /^    async def run_image_gen(self, prompt: str) -> AsyncGenerator[Frame, None]:$/
